comment: Hand-written cowdiff states for f_100083b0. The fuzzers will not hit the counting branch by chance: bit 0 of the object's byte at +0x1c has to be set, and then the counter pointer has to be real. where is arena | stack | image (the harness resolves them) or an absolute guest address.

states.note: flag bit 0 set, counter in the arena at +0x40 starting at 7: the increment must happen
flag clear (bit 1 only), counter at 0xffffffff: no increment, and the counter stays at -1
flag set and the counter at the top of the stack region: an increment that touches a page edge
